pre_build: mkdir -p build && python3 tools/gen_schwung.py && python3 tools/gen_web_ui.py
upstream_build: scripts/build.sh: python3 tools/gen_schwung.py (writes module.json, src/schwung_meta.h) + tools/gen_web_ui.py; gcc -O2 -Iengine -Ivendor/schwung -Ivendor/mpc-vst-plugins -Isrc engine/*.c src/schwung_plugin.c -lpthread; dist {module.json,help.json,web_ui.html,assets/*,dsp.so}
wasm_notes: -D_GNU_SOURCE (sched_setscheduler/sched_setaffinity no-ops now come from compat/include/schwung_module_prelude.h): the worker thread calls sched_setscheduler/sched_setaffinity (demote from SCHED_FIFO, keep off core 3). musl only declares them under _GNU_SOURCE, and Emscripten's libc omits musl src/sched entirely, so without the hidden-visibility no-op stubs the worker traps on an unresolved import. Engine is created on the worker thread; silent until it is up (~100 ms), so the 40x-faster-than-realtime test needs realtime pacing (test.realtime, not yet implemented by testhost). Verified audible (-24 dBFS rms) with a paced host, default and threaded.
